Open question: Permanent maximum Willpower loss is a thing the site has never done
Why it is open, and what I would do: Every other cost on the site is spent and comes back. This one does not. It is also the whole idea of the set, so it cannot be softened without losing it. See the Special Feature tab.

Open question: The tier ladder is slower than every other set
Why it is open, and what I would do: Adept at Rank 3, Master at Rank 5. Every other set in the pass reaches Adept at 2 and Master at 3, and so do the Mycomancer, Duelist, Colossus and Guardian on the site. Either normalise it, or keep it slow on the grounds that a free cast is worth waiting for. I would normalise, for consistency.

Open question: A Physique caster with no spell list of their own
